name: copilot-byok-manager
description: Local control plane for GitHub Copilot clients

scripts.check:web: npm run check:i18n && node --check apps/desktop/web/ui-lifecycle.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/app.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/manager-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/inline-deployment.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/model-discovery.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/installer-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/account-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/github-auth-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/deployment-review.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/setup-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/jetbrains-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/usage-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/resources-ui.js && node --check apps/desktop/web/plan-session.js && node --test apps/desktop/web/tests/*.test.cjs && npm run test:web
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:rust
